description: MagPy derives magnetic-complexity and free-energy proxies from SDO vector magnetograms. Historical eruption rates and probabilistic calculations then produce forecasts for several solar-event classes. The resource is documented by NASA JSC SRAG; Princeton University. The documented physical domain is Solar; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Continuous/RT Run (ISWA data tree), Continuous/RT Run (Flare Scoreboard), Continuous/RT Run (ISWA layout). A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The documented filter excludes strongly foreshortened regions near the solar limb. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
